title: The Biological Clock
text: Plants need a way to measure time and detect day length. They use a special blue-green pigment found in leaves that can absorb red light.

title: Phytochrome System
text: Phytochrome ('phyto' = plant, 'chrome' = color) exists in two forms. In daylight, Pr converts to Pfr. In darkness, Pfr slowly converts back to Pr. The ratio tells the plant how long it has been dark.
